title: Reson: an open-source EMG binary switch pipeline
description: Reson is an early-stage, open-source electromyography (EMG) binary switch pipeline built on low-cost hardware (ESP32 + AD8232). It provides serial ingestion, feature extraction, interval-labeled and prompted data collection, baseline model training, and a runtime that emits binary switch down/up events, intended as a click layer for assistive human-machine interfaces such as eye-tracking cursor systems.
